```{r define-scenarios, include=FALSE}
# Define scenario configurations
# Each scenario modifies one or more base-case parameters

# First, get base case for Model B (primary specification)
MODEL_STRUCTURE <<- 1

suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/06_parametric_survival_analysis.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/07_basecase_input_parameters.R"))
}))

base_params <- l_params_base

# Define scenarios
scenario_defs <- list(
  list(
    name = "Base case",
    description = "Model B, 10-year horizon, 4% discount, base pricing",
    params = base_params
  ),
  list(
    name = "Biosimilar pricing",
    description = "Nivolumab at 80% discount from list (EUR 4,641/admin)",
    params = within(base_params, {
      c_drug_nivo <- 4641
    })
  ),
  list(
    name = "WTP EUR 100,000",
    description = "Higher WTP threshold (EUR 100,000/QALY)",
    params = base_params,
    wtp_override = 100000
  ),
  list(
    name = "Discount rate 0%",
    description = "No discounting of costs and effects",
    params = within(base_params, {
      dr_costs <- 0
      dr_effects <- 0
    })
  ),
  list(
    name = "Discount rate 8%",
    description = "Higher discount rate (8% for both costs and effects)",
    params = within(base_params, {
      dr_costs <- 0.08
      dr_effects <- 0.08
    })
  ),
  list(
    name = "Literature utilities",
    description = "Literature-based utility values (u_np=0.80, u_p=0.65)",
    params = within(base_params, {
      u_np <- 0.80
      u_p <- 0.65
    })
  )
)
```

```{r run-scenarios, include=FALSE}
strategy_labels <- c(
  "control" = "Standard care",
  "crp" = "CRP-guided",
  "tmb_braf" = "TMB/BRAF-guided",
  "tlr" = "TLR-guided"
)

scenario_results <- data.frame()

for (scenario in scenario_defs) {
  cat("Running scenario:", scenario$name, "\n")

  result <- model_fun(scenario$params)

  # Calculate ICERs
  icer_obj <- dampack::calculate_icers(
    cost = result$Cost,
    effect = result$Effect,
    strategies = result$Strategy
  )
  icer_df <- as.data.frame(icer_obj)

  # Determine WTP for this scenario
  scenario_wtp <- if (!is.null(scenario$wtp_override)) scenario$wtp_override else WTP

  # Calculate NMB
  nmb <- result$Effect * scenario_wtp - result$Cost
  optimal_idx <- which.max(nmb)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(icer_df))) {
    icer_display <- if (icer_df$Status[i] %in% c("D", "ED")) {
      "Dominated"
    } else if (is.na(icer_df$ICER[i])) {
      "Reference"
    } else {
      sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(icer_df$ICER[i]), big.mark = ","))
    }

    scenario_results <- rbind(scenario_results, data.frame(
      Scenario = scenario$name,
      Strategy = strategy_labels[icer_df$Strategy[i]],
      Cost = icer_df$Cost[i],
      QALYs = icer_df$Effect[i],
      ICER = icer_display,
      NMB = nmb[i],
      Optimal = ifelse(i == optimal_idx, "Yes", ""),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}

cat("Scenario results:", nrow(scenario_results), "rows\n")
```

```{r display-full-table}
display_df <- scenario_results %>%
  mutate(
    Cost = sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(Cost), big.mark = ",")),
    QALYs = sprintf("%.2f", QALYs),
    NMB = sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(NMB), big.mark = ","))
  )

kable(display_df,
      caption = "Table S8: Scenario analyses - cost-effectiveness results under alternative assumptions (Model B)",
      format = "html",
      align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "c")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 11) %>%
  pack_rows(index = table(factor(display_df$Scenario, levels = unique(display_df$Scenario)))) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "All scenarios use Model B (focused) specification unless otherwise noted.",
      paste0("Base case: 10-year horizon, 4% discount rate, WTP = \u20AC", format(WTP, big.mark = ","), "/QALY."),
      "Biosimilar pricing: nivolumab at EUR 4,641/administration (80% discount from list price, 67% reduction from base-case procurement price).",
      "Literature utilities: progression-free = 0.80, post-progression = 0.65 (based on Joranger et al. 2020).",
      "NMB = net monetary benefit at scenario-specific WTP threshold.",
      "Optimal = strategy with highest NMB at the given WTP threshold."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

## Summary: Optimal Strategy by Scenario

```{r summary-table}
summary_df <- scenario_results %>%
  group_by(Scenario) %>%
  filter(Optimal == "Yes") %>%
  select(Scenario, `Optimal Strategy` = Strategy, NMB) %>%
  mutate(NMB = sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(NMB), big.mark = ",")))

kable(summary_df,
      caption = "Optimal strategy by scenario",
      format = "html",
      row.names = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12)
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) {
  dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

write.csv(scenario_results, file = here("tables", "table_s8.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Table saved to:", here("tables", "table_s8.csv"), "\n")
```
